name: Panoptic Radiance Field
definition: A novel approach for learning panoptic 3D volumetric representations from images of in-the-wild scenes. It represents a static 3D scene as a panoptic radiance field that generates a unified and multi-view consistent, 3D panoptic representation of the scene, lifting noisy 2D segmentation masks into a consistent 3D representation.
summary: Panoptic Radiance Field lifts noisy 2D segmentation masks into a consistent 3D representation of color, density, semantics, and instance identifiers without requiring manual ground truth.
